bounded.title: Bounded stores
bounded.description: Two fixed-size stores ride with every system prompt: the agent’s notes and your profile. Overflow is refused, never truncated.
bounded.failedLoad: Failed to load the bounded stores.
bounded.emptyDesc: Approved additions appear here and ride with the next session prompt.
bounded.frozenDesc: The session prompt was built from a snapshot frozen at session start; edits apply from the next session.
bounded.frozenChanged: Changed since the frozen snapshot — the next session will pick this up.

score.title: Retrieval score
score.label: Memory score: {{score}}%
score.relevanceUnavailable: Relevance is available only when this memory came from a ranked recall.

drawer.deleteDescription: It is archived rather than erased, but it will no longer be recalled.
drawer.discardDescription: Your edits to this memory have not been saved yet.

reminders.subtitle: One-off or repeating, run by the same scheduler as every other task.
reminders.failedRun: Could not run the reminder now.
reminders.emptyDesc: Create a reminder to fire once at a date and time, or on a repeating rhythm.
reminders.confirmDeleteDesc: The reminder and its run history are removed permanently — there is no undo.
reminders.help: Once fires at a date and time; repeating accepts plain English, Persian, or a cron expression.
reminders.textPlaceholder: e.g. Renew the insurance by Mehr 15
reminders.rhythmPlaceholder: every day at 9 AM · هر روز ساعت ۹ صبح · 0 9 * * *
reminders.previewEmpty: Type a rhythm to preview it.
reminders.previewInvalidDate: The date and time must be in the future.
reminders.previewOnce: Fires once, at the chosen date and time.
